tool_input.description: Bind H15 sanctioned-script matching to realpath
tool_input.prompt:
Change how the store guard decides that a script is sanctioned. Today the allowlist entry is compared against the path string the command names, so a copy of a sanctioned script placed outside the plugin clone still satisfies the exemption and gets write access to the store. Resolve both the active plugin root and the candidate script through realpath and require the candidate to sit inside the clone root before granting the exemption; a symlink that points back into the clone must not launder an outside script. Keep the documented remedies runnable.
REVIEW-TERRITORY: ["scripts/hooks/h15-store-guard.mjs"]
